app.name: Reitti
app.tagline: Find the right kind of help, at the right level, at a cost that works.
app.notDiagnosis: Reitti does not diagnose. It suggests a sensible starting point based on rules a clinician has approved.
app.onDevice: Your answers stay on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
result.fittingRungs.heading: These steps fit what you described
result.fittingRungs.help: They run from the lightest to the most intensive, not in order of preference. Which one is right depends on things this page cannot see, so read them and pick the one that sounds like you.
result.youChoose: You choose. Nothing here is booked, sent, or decided for you.
result.howChosen.foot: These are the rules a clinician approved, quoted as written. Nothing here was generated for you.
result.band.heading: What you answered
result.scopeStatement.title: What this is, and what it is not
result.scopeStatement.body: Reitti gives guidance and information. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose, and it does not decide anything about your care. Nothing here replaces a conversation with a professional. The decision stays with you and with them.
result.heading: Your options
result.tags.heading: What to look for
result.clearData: Delete everything Reitti has stored on this device
result.adjacent.below: If that feels like too much, start here
result.adjacent.above: If that doesn't feel like enough
rung2.heading: Someone to talk to, free, now
rung2.help: None of these is an emergency service. If you are in danger, or thinking about ending your life, use the crisis help. It is on every screen.
ladder.heading: Every step, and what it costs
ladder.help: The whole ladder, not only the steps that fit you today. Costs are typical, not quotes.
ladder.budgetQuestion: What can you spend right now?
ladder.reorderedFree: Free and public routes are listed first. Everything else is still here.
ladder.reorderedClinical: Listed from the lightest step to the most intensive.
ladder.nothingHidden: Your budget changes the order of this list. It never removes anything from it. You can always see every option, whatever you can spend.
human.heading: If you would rather talk it through with someone
human.help: You do not have to decide any of this on your own, and you do not need a referral or an appointment to talk to a person today.
human.publicRoute: Or go through the public system
human.ensijasennys: Contact your own health station and ask for an ensijäsennys, the first assessment appointment. That is the door to a referral, to nettiterapia, and eventually to Kela-supported therapy.
whileYouWait.heading: While you wait
whileYouWait.help: Referrals take time. These are things you can use in the meantime, alongside the referral rather than instead of it.
whileYouWait.selfHelp: Something to work through on your own
whileYouWait.peer: Someone to talk to in the meantime
whileYouWait.waitlist: Put your hand up for a group
app.footerCrisis: In an emergency call 112; for crisis support call the MIELI ry crisis line on 09 2525 0111.

context.domain.help: Pick whatever is closest. You can be wrong. This only shapes which questions we ask next.
context.duration.question: How long has this been going on?
context.duration.help: A rough sense is fine. Duration tells short-term support apart from longer therapy.
context.budget.question: What can you spend on support right now?

context.language.question: Which language do you want support in?
context.language.help: This is about the care we point you to, not the language of this page.
context.ageBand.question: How old are you?
context.ageBand.help: We ask because some services are only for young people, and some only for adults. This stays on your device.

home.title: The access layer for Finnish mental health care
home.lede: Most services can tell you who exists. They cannot tell you what would actually help. Reitti starts from what you are carrying right now and points you to the kind of support that fits it: free self-help, a group, guided online therapy, or sessions one to one.
home.assurance.onDevice: Your answers stay on this device
home.ladder.title: The stepped-care ladder
home.ladder.foot: Every step here is real care. Starting lower down is not settling for less. Matching the help to what you actually need is how this is meant to work, and it keeps the scarce places free for the people who need them most.
home.values.lede: Two things. Everything else we build is in service of one of them.
home.value1.title: The right kind of help
home.value1.body: A few short questions, no diagnosis, and you are pointed toward the kind of care that fits. Not just toward whoever happens to have a slot free.
home.value1.foot: Scored against published cutoffs, using rules a clinician has approved. No guesswork, no diagnosis, and no AI anywhere near the decision.
home.value2.title: Reachable for anyone
home.value2.body: Steps you can actually afford, groups instead of one to one, and a way to start a group where none exists yet. Help you can reach on any budget.
home.value2.foot: Free and public options come first whenever that makes clinical sense. What you can spend changes the order we show things in. It never hides anything from you.
home.gaps.title: Discovery is solved. Access is not.
home.gaps.lede: Listings tell you a therapist exists. They do not tell you whether anyone is taking new clients, whether Kela will cover it, or the question underneath all of that: what you should be looking for in the first place.
home.gap.01.title: You cannot tell who is free
home.gap.01.body: Directories list who exists, not who has room for you. So you email one therapist after another to find out.
home.gap.02.title: Nobody explains the Kela path
home.gap.02.body: Whether you qualify, which method, which language, who has space: it all lives in different places, so nobody ever sees it in one view.
home.gap.03.title: There is no front door
home.gap.03.body: To get started you already have to know whether you need self-help, a group, nettiterapia or Kela psychotherapy. Most people asking for help for the first time do not.
home.gap.04.title: Everything is in pieces
home.gap.04.body: Public services and private providers each hold one piece of the picture. Nobody holds a current view of what you could actually reach today.
home.gap.05.title: Your language narrows it further
home.gap.05.body: Finding support in Swedish, English or another language, with someone who actually has room, is mostly guesswork today.
home.compare.title: The same search, two ways
home.compare.lede: Click through the first one and see where it stops.
home.reitti.3: See what you can actually reach there
home.reitti.4: Or start free self-help today, while you wait
home.start.lede: Three ways in. Pick whichever sounds most like you.
home.entry1.title: Not sure what you need?
home.entry1.body: A few short questions to help you work out where to start, anywhere from free self-help to Kela-funded psychotherapy. It is guidance, not a medical assessment.
home.entry2.title: Individual therapy is not the only first step
home.entry2.body: Groups led by professionals, workshops and free peer support work well for a lot of common difficulties, at a fraction of the cost. And if the right group does not exist near you yet, we want to start one.
home.entry3.title: Preparing for a first session?
home.entry3.body: Short questionnaires help you see what is under the most strain. You can print a summary and hand it to a therapist, so the first session starts where it matters.
previews.lede: None of this exists yet. It is here so you can see where the ladder leads once therapists are onboarded, not to imply a directory we do not have.
previews.card1.title: Find a therapist
previews.card1.body: Search verified therapists by approach, language, price and availability. Registration is checked against Valvira's public register, and availability is confirmed by the therapist rather than guessed.
previews.card2.title: Groups and workshops
previews.card2.body: Professionally led groups at a fraction of individual cost. When enough people are waiting for the same kind of group in the same place, Reitti starts one.
previews.card3.title: Track how you're doing
previews.card3.body: Re-take a short wellbeing check every few weeks and see the trend. It is yours to keep, and yours to share with a therapist if you want to.
assessment.englishOnly.title: The questions are only in English for now
assessment.englishOnly.body: The screening questionnaires have to use their official validated translation, because a hand-translated question measures something different. We do not have the official Finnish and Swedish versions yet, so we do not offer them. Everything else on this site is in your language, and so is every service we point you to.
waitlist.heading: No group near you? Put your hand up
waitlist.help: Groups only run when enough people want the same one in the same place. Registering interest is how one gets started. You are not booking anything and you are not committing to anything.
waitlist.join: Tell me if this group forms
waitlist.joined: Your hand is up. We cannot contact you, so check back here. We hold nothing that could reach you.
waitlist.ready: Enough people are waiting. This topic is flagged for a facilitator.
waitlist.consent: This will send three things and nothing else: the topic ({topic}), the region ({region}) and the language ({language}). No answers, no scores, nothing that identifies you or this device. One number goes up.
waitlist.privacy: Reitti's server holds counts, not people. There is no way for us to link a count back to you, which is also why we cannot tell you when a group forms.
group.low-mood.name: A group for low mood
group.low-mood.description: A structured group working through low mood together, led by a professional.
group.anxiety.name: A group for anxiety
group.anxiety.description: A structured group for worry, tension and panic, led by a professional.
group.burnout.name: A group for burnout and work strain
group.burnout.description: For exhaustion that built up at work, with people in the same situation.
group.loneliness.name: A group for loneliness and connection
group.loneliness.description: Loneliness is one of the few things a group answers better than an individual session, by its nature.
group.grief.name: A bereavement group
group.grief.description: For loss, with people who are carrying something similar.
followUp.heading: Did you get in?
followUp.help: You used Reitti a while ago. Whether people actually get in is the only way we can tell if any of this works, and whether to keep pushing the counties for more capacity.
followUp.privacy: One of three numbers goes up. We do not send which step you were pointed at, what you scored, or when you answered. Only which of these three buttons was pressed.
waitlist.regionQuestion: Where would you go to a group?
youth.heading: Reitti is built for adults. Here is where to go instead.
youth.body: We are an adult service, so the rest of this site is not built for you and pointing you at it would not be doing you a favour. The services below are built for people your age, they are free, and they are open now. The crisis help at the bottom of the screen is for you too.
youth.crisisNote: If things feel urgent right now, use the crisis help. It is on every screen and it is for everyone, whatever your age.
entryPoints.heading: You can start here, without answering anything
entryPoints.help: These are free, public and open to you right now. No account, no referral, no questions from us. If you already know what you need, take it. Our questions are a way in, not a gate you have to pass.
entryPoints.foot: Not sure which of these fits? That is what the questions below are for.
home.subtitle: The right kind of help, at the right level. And actually within reach.
